notes: TEST VECTORS ONLY. The two wallets below are derived from the published seeds and hold nothing; never use them.
message: one line of printable ASCII, no trailing newline; it is byte for byte SolanaBurnRouter.exitMessage(burner, amount, recipient, nonce) or redirectMessage(burner, burnId, recipient, nonce).

proof (the bytes given to the router): tag | 64-byte Ed25519 signature [| 32-byte application domain]. tag 0: the signature covers the UTF-8 bytes of the message (wallet signMessage). tag 1: it covers 0xff "solana offchain" | 0x00 | 0x00 | length u16 little-endian | message (solana sign-offchain-message, Agave CLI 4.4.1). tag 2: it covers 0xff "solana offchain" | 0x00 | application domain (32) | 0x00 | 0x01 | signer (32) | length u16 little-endian | message.
Ed25519 signatures are deterministic (RFC 8032): signing the message with the seed must reproduce the signature exactly.
